candidate.rationale: Deallocation is modeled solely by consuming the linear PointsToRaw and Dealloc resources. The function has no modeled output or post-state liveness predicate, so no useful postcondition is expressible.
risks: Restating preconditions or properties of the unit result would be redundant and semantically unusable.
Claiming that p is freed or invalid would require an allocation-liveness model that vstd does not expose here.
